An algorithm for multiplication of trigintaduonions [![Image 3: Scispace (Formerly Typeset)](http://scispace.com/scispace-logo-square.svg)](http://scispace.com/) Sign up[Pricing](http://scispace.com/pricing?pricing_hook=header-hook) Open Access Journal Article An algorithm for multiplication of trigintaduonions =================================================== [Alexandr Cariow,](http://scispace.com/authors/alexandr-cariow-3bgyqmhbdv)[Galina Cariowa](http://scispace.com/authors/galina-cariowa-3z9yfxyu8d) +1 more[West Pomeranian University of Technology](http://scispace.com/institutions/west-pomeranian-university-of-technology-85403iec) -01 Jan[2014](http://scispace.com/journals/applied-computer-science-3cq8pxyw/2014) -[Applied Computer Science](http://scispace.com/journals/applied-computer-science-3cq8pxyw) -Vol. 8 Show Less Podcast 7 Get PDF Save Cite TL;DR: This paper introduces efficient algorithm for the multiplication of trigintaduonions and shows how to compute a trigintADuonion product with 498 real multiplications and 943 real additions. Abstract:In this paper we introduce efficient algorithm for the multiplication of trigintaduonions. The direct multiplication of two trigintaduonions requires 1024 real multiplications and 992 real additions. We show how to compute a trigintaduonion product with 498 real multiplications and 943 real additions. During synthesis of the discussed algorithm we use a fact that trigintaduonion multipli- cation may be represented by a vector-matrix product. Such representation provides a possibility to discover repeating elements in the matrix structure and to use specific properties of their mutual placement to decrease the number of real multiplications needed to compute the product of two trigintaduonions. read more [Show Related Papers](http://scispace.com/search?q=An+algorithm+for+multiplication+of+trigintaduonions) ##### Chat with Paper * Explain Abstract of this paper * Conclusions from the paper * Results of the paper Show more ##### AI Agents for this Paper * Find similar papers on Google Scholar, PubMed and Arxiv * Write a critical review of this paper * Analyze citations of this paper to find unaddressed research gaps Show more ##### Citations Sort by: Citation Count PDF Open Access Filters Showing all 7 results •Posted Content [Derivation of a low multiplicative complexity algorithm for multiplying hyperbolic octonions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------](http://scispace.com/papers/derivation-of-a-low-multiplicative-complexity-algorithm-for-4awum58gab) [Aleksandr Cariow,](http://scispace.com/authors/aleksandr-cariow-1e09usmx5h)[Galina Cariowa,](http://scispace.com/authors/galina-cariowa-3z9yfxyu8d)[Jaroslaw Knapinski](http://scispace.com/authors/jaroslaw-knapinski-228mvim2l4) +2 more[West Pomeranian University of Technology](http://scispace.com/institutions/west-pomeranian-university-of-technology-85403iec) -22 Feb[2015](http://scispace.com/journals/arxiv-data-structures-and-algorithms-1sdoqlck/2015) -[arXiv: Data Structures and Algorithms](http://scispace.com/journals/arxiv-data-structures-and-algorithms-1sdoqlck) Show Less -
